title: openJiuwen: Beyond Static Harnesses for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.27969v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon coding agents operate over evolving repository states while increasingly relying on heterogeneous capabilities, delegated agents, and multi-agent coordination. These trends pose two complementary challenges for the agent harness. First, developers need to compose capabilities, reconfigure execution logic, and scale increasingly complex agent systems without repeatedly rebuilding orchestration. Second, complex coding tasks continuously produce new evidence---such as semantic diagnostics, execution outcomes, task progress, and changing context relevance---that should dynamically influence subsequent runtime decisions. We characterize these challenges as Structural Composability and Runtime Adaptivity. We present openJiuwen, an open-source harness designed for both developer composability and adaptive task execution. openJiuwen provides a shared execution substrate and Rail-based capability composition across single agents,

translated_title: openJiuwen：超越静态框架的长时程编码智能体系统
translated_abstract: 长时程编码智能体在不断演化的仓库状态上运行，同时日益依赖异构能力、委派智能体以及多智能体协同。这些趋势为智能体框架带来了两个互补的挑战：首先，开发者需要能够组合能力、重新配置执行逻辑并扩展日益复杂的智能体系统，而无需反复重建编排流程；其次，复杂的编码任务会持续产生新的证据——例如语义诊断信息、执行结果、任务进度以及不断变化的上下文相关性——这些证据应当能够动态影响后续的运行时决策。我们将这两类挑战概括为“结构可组合性”与“运行时自适应性”。我们提出了 openJiuwen，一个同时面向开发者可组合性与自适应任务执行的开源框架。openJiuwen 提供了共享的执行底座以及基于 Rail 的能力组合机制，支持跨单个智能体的……
tldr: openJiuwen 是一个开源智能体框架，通过“结构可组合性”与“运行时自适应性”两大设计，使长时程编码智能体能够灵活组合能力并根据任务产生的动态证据自适应调整执行。
en_tdlr: openJiuwen is an open-source agent harness that addresses structural composability and runtime adaptivity, enabling long-horizon coding agents to flexibly compose capabilities and adapt execution to dynamically generated task evidence.
